newsitem.title: USA: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-HOLMGREN WARNS PACKERS ABOUT "WEIRD WOMEN".
newsitem.headline: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-HOLMGREN WARNS PACKERS ABOUT "WEIRD WOMEN".

text.p: Green Bay head coach Mike Holmgren has given his troops some pointers about staying out of trouble in this notorious party town in the days leading up to Super Bowl XXXI.

The Packers, who arrived in "the Big Easy" on Sunday, were immediately hit with a 1:30 a.m. curfew by their usually laid-back commander and chief, who experienced a Super Bowl in New Orleans as offensive coordinator for the San Francisco 49ers seven years ago.

Green Bay all-pro safety LeRoy Butler said Holmgren advised his players on Sunday to stay away from Bourbon Street -- heart of the French Quarter party scene -- and the Mississippi River gambling boat.
He also told his players to avoid weird women.
Butler's brother, who lives in New Orleans, shed some light on that warning.
"He said 'if you are going to chase girls, make sure it's a girl,'" Butler said.
